reg_names.reason: The ADT gives no window names. By position the layout equals the M4 (T8132) `ane,t8020` node; window roles are not measured.

segment_ranges.reason: No segment-ranges on the ANE node in the IPSW ADT. iBoot adds it at boot (T6021 precedent). Needs the live ADT of a booted machine (phram "adt" region, read-only).

tunables.reason: No tunable properties on dart-ane in the IPSW ADT. ANE tunables are compiled into the per-SoC HAL kext (tunableh_* tables, see kext.hal); their values are not extracted.

node.reason: No ANE mailbox or ASC node in the IPSW ADT (searched /arm-io for ane*, *exclave*, and compatibles with "ane"). The macOS class binds the ane node itself, as on T6021, where the ASC and its mailbox sit inside reg[0] (engine+0x1400000/+0x1408000). For H17 that offset is not measured.

protocol.v: RTKit (RTBuddy endpoints) with the CSNE_CMD host command set: 96 CSNE_CMD names, including EXCLAVE_MODE_START/STOP and SECURE_MODE_*; RTKit string RTKit_release-3514.0.15.

protocol_vs_h14.v: The 27.0 H14 image (t602x selene) has the same 96 CSNE_CMD names and the same RTKit_release-3514.0.15 string; its PowerControl, TM and engine-loop sources are the H14 variants

class.v: H11ANEIn, personality t8132exclave: IONameMatch ane,t8132exclave, provider AppleARMIODevice, IOProbeScore 10000 (the t8020 personality binds the same class to ane,t8020)

exclave.v: ANEExclaveProxy (IONameMatch ane,ane-exclave-proxy / ane,ane1-exclave-proxy; no such node in this ADT); H11ANEIn strings: exclaveSetup, CSNE_CMD_EXCLAVE_MODE_START/STOP, checkExclaveEnablementStatus, exclave-assigned

protocol.v: rtbuddy endpoints (ANEEndpoint, SetupEndpoints, EnableRTBuddyEndpoints) and CSNE_CMD commands; reads segment-ranges and ane-type

hwx_generation.v: H17: ANECCompile target h17 emits HWX Mach-O cpusubtype 9 (h16: 7, h15: 6, h14: 5, h13: 4)

aurora.reason: No t6050 file in aurora-wip arch/arm64/boot/dts/apple (listed with git ls-tree at the aurora-wip head used for t8140).

ane1_j775d.reason: The j775d ADT was not read. receipts/2026-10-01-ane-every-soc/adt-27.0.txt:197-199 lists j775d ane1 as ane,t8020 at 0x4308000000+0x2000000 (die-id 1, interrupt 4058; dart-ane1 at 0x4309800000, interrupt 4059). That summary prints no exclave property for any node (ane0 shows none there, but the full j714c ADT has exclave-assigned on ane0), so whether ane1 is exclave-assigned is not measured. The BuildManifest gives Ap,ANE1 IsLoadedByiBoot false (source B1).
